answer: What survives to the voyage is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the hollow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
